pages.note: Added the cluster's unanswered questions as FAQ (FAQPage via FaqBlock): how much is the credit, how to claim it, how to get free solar panels, does California tax solar, business incentives (26 USC 48E(e)(4) cutoff), Solar for All status. Added a 'Utility solar programs' group to the spoke directory and a paragraph under the incentives table linking the three new utility guides and the commercial financing page (where the cluster's 'commercial' impressions land). pages.title: PG&E Solar Programs in 2026: What Is Open and What Is Not
pages.note: Program-by-program table with status on 2026-09-23: Solar Billing Plan, Green Saver (at capacity, auto-enrollment), Solar Choice (enrollment on hold, D.21-12-036), DAC-SASH, SOMAH, SGIP, Generator and Battery Rebate (portable only). Answers 'does PG&E have a solar program', 'free solar program', 'solar battery program', 'Solar Choice'. Billing plan kept to a summary so it does not compete with the battery lane's /blog/pge-solar-billing-plan (link requested). CARE sub-questions deferred to /blog/income-qualified-bill-discount-pge.

pages.title: SMUD Solar Program 2026: Export Rate, Rebates, SolarShares
pages.note: No SMUD solar rebate (SMUD's own words); Solar and Storage Rate 9.6c/kWh exports from 2026-06-01; legacy NEM to 2030-12-31; sizing 110%/120%; interconnection steps; battery incentive cut to $300/kWh (max $6,000) effective 2026-09-23 with the grandfathering rule; SolarShares per-kW charge/credit table years 1-12 (years 13-20 not in page text, so not shown). Not duplicated with the rates lane's /blog/smud-peak-hours (no TOU hours here).

pages.title: LADWP Solar Programs 2026: Rooftops, Shared Solar, Rebates
pages.note: Built as the all-programs LADWP page (the query covers more than Solar Rooftops, which keeps its own deep page and is linked). ladwp.com returns 403 to WebFetch; every LADWP page was fetched with curl on 2026-09-23 and read from its text. Covers: no rebate on owned systems, Solar Rooftops summary, Shared Solar with 2026 rates vs Tier 1 ($0.29624/$0.28124 vs $0.26408), SGIP through LADWP (RSSE cost-verification update, lottery is not an award), FiT prices and capacity, VNEM pilot. Partial only because the CREATE_DEDICATED holder link is needed from /solar-companies/los-angeles (not owned here; link requested). Net metering detail left to the battery lane's /blog/ladwp-net-metering (link requested once it exists).
